title: Gold Short-Term Disappointment and Long-Term Trends
tldr: Gold's safe-haven property failed amid geopolitical shocks, with 17% drawdown. Long-term fundamentals intact: de-dollarization, central bank buying, and real rate plus CB purchases framework still valid.
abstract: Since March, geopolitical tensions impacted global risk appetite, but gold failed to show safe-haven properties, instead moving in tandem with risk assets. Gold's maximum drawdown exceeded 17% after the US-Israel-Iran conflict before rebounding on de-escalation. The report identifies four causes: elevated positioning and crowded longs, rapid shift from safe-haven to stagflation/liquidity tightening trades, forced central bank gold sales under fiscal pressure, and capital diversion to energy commodities. Short-term, monetary policy factors outweigh safe-haven attributes. Long-term, the underlying logic remains intact — geopolitical order restructuring, US debt sustainability concerns, central bank purchases, Fed rate cuts, and scarcity of safe assets. The real interest rate plus central bank gold purchases pricing framework retains explanatory power. Recommended strategy: buy on dips or wait for volatility convergence.
strategy: The core strategy is to buy gold on dips during corrections or wait for volatility to converge before entering positions. [source: "逢调整增持或待波动率收敛后出手可能是合适的应对方式"] Short-term, gold faces multiple crosscurrents with reduced tail risk but elevated volatility. If the Strait of Hormuz opens and oil prices adjust, gold may rebound modestly; if geopolitical tensions escalate again, gold may face further downside. [source: "若霍尔木兹海峡开通，油价调整，黄金或温和反弹，反之若局势进一步升级，黄金仍有调整风险"] Medium-to-long-term, gold's underlying logic remains unbroken until global order restructuring reaches a new steady state. The real interest rate plus central bank purchases pricing framework still holds. [source: "实际利率 + 央行购金的定价框架仍有一定解释力度"] Key risk: if the Fed enters an active rate-hiking cycle, it could trigger sharp gold corrections. [source: "美联储如果进入主动加息周期，可能也会引发黄金的剧烈调整"] Monitor when gold exits the inflation-liquidity dominated environment; watch gold's correlation with oil and US equities as important observation variables. [source: "关注何时走出通胀→流动性主导的市场环境，黄金与原油、美股等资产相关性的变化是重要观测变量"]
method: The report employs a multi-factor analytical framework for gold pricing, centered on the real interest rate plus central bank gold purchases model. [source: "实际利率+央行购金框架依然有效"] The analysis proceeds along three dimensions: (1) US real interest rates as opportunity cost for private sector gold buying — examining how nominal rate increases from overtightened monetary policy exceeded inflation expectations, with further upside assessed as limited under fundamental logic. [source: "美国实际利率更多刻画私人部门购金的机会成本，短期更多受地缘和流动性影响，基本面逻辑下进一步上行空间或有限"] (2) Central bank gold purchase behavior — examining patterns including forced sales under fiscal pressure (not generalizable), priority of selling Treasuries before gold, slowing purchase scale but increasing number of participating central banks, and China's tactical buy-on-dip approach. [source: "央行购金叙事略有松动，但净增持的大趋势仍未逆转"] (3) Technical indicators — speculative position clearing, non-commercial net longs returning to reasonable range, and gold ETF volume/volatility crowding metrics declining from highs. [source: "前期投机头寸部分出清，非商业期货净多头回落至合理区间，黄金ETF 成交量/波动率等拥挤度指标高位回落"]
experiment: (1) Position analysis — COMEX gold speculative longs near January 2026 levels, net longs at five-year highs before the correction. [source: "COMEX 黄金期货和期权多头投机头寸接近 2026 年 1 月水平，净多头头寸处于近五年来相对高位"] (2) Central bank behavior — Turkey sold about 120 tons of gold in March's last two weeks, the largest two-week decline since 2013. China's PBOC net purchased 160,000 ounces (about 5 tons) in March, equal to the prior five months combined. [source: "土耳其央行在 3 月最后两周抛售约 120 吨黄金，为 2013 年有相关记录以来最大两周降幅"] [source: "中国央行...净增持 16 万盎司（约 5 吨），规模相当于过去五个月增持量的总和"] (3) Fund flows — US Oil Fund saw 700 million USD inflows in March, while the largest gold ETF shed about 54 tons. [source: "美国原油基金...3 月累计流入 7 亿美元...全球最大的黄金 ETF 3 月减持了约 54 吨黄金"] (4) Rate expectations — OIS priced zero Fed cuts for 2026 as of April 4, versus 60bp before the conflict. [source: "截至 4 月 4 日，OIS 市场定价美联储年内不降息，而冲突爆发前为降息 60bp"]
result: Gold experienced a maximum drawdown exceeding 17% since the March conflict before rebounding on de-escalation. [source: "最大回撤一度超过 17%"] The real interest rate plus central bank purchases framework remains valid. Central bank net purchases slowed to about 860 tons in 2025 (down about 230 tons from 2024), but more central banks joined the buying. [source: "2025 年全年净增持约 860 吨，较 2024 年下降约 230 吨"] China's PBOC accelerated purchases to 5 tons in March. Speculative positions partially cleared, with non-commercial net longs returning to reasonable levels and crowding indicators declining. [source: "非商业期货净多头回落至合理区间"] Short-term, gold faces multiple crosscurrents with reduced tail risk; medium-to-long-term, the upward trend remains intact supported by geopolitical restructuring, de-dollarization, and Fed rate cut expectations, though an active Fed hiking cycle poses downside risk.
